LESSON: HEALTHY RELATIONSHIPS - EFFECTIVE COMMUNICATION - NEGOTIATION SKILLS - EMPATHY - ASSERTIVENESS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People, Population and Relationships
Topic 3.6: Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness, part of People, Population and Relationships in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we promote healthy relationship in the community?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign terms and concepts related to healthy relationships in the community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. explain ways of sustaining healthy relationships in the community,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. explore barriers to harmonious relationships,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. use strategies to overcome barriers to healthy relationships ,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

E. appreciate the need for healthy relationships in the community. ●

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. sign terms and concepts related to healthy relationships in the community,

   Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. explain ways of sustaining healthy relationships in the community,

   Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. explore barriers to harmonious relationships,

   Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. use strategies to overcome barriers to healthy relationships ,

   Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. appreciate the need for healthy relationships in the community. ●

   Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Healthy relationships - Effective communication - negotiation skills - empathy - assertiveness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: learners develop speaking and signing skills clearly and effectively as they discuss in groups,

barriers to harmonious relationships.

● Creativity and imagination: learners undertake tasks as they role play scenarios that depict effective communication, negotiation skills,

empathy, and assertiveness in overcoming barriers to healthy relationships.

Values:
● Peace: learners respects self and others as they role play scenarios that depict effective communication, negotiation skills, empathy,

assertiveness in overcoming barriers to healthy relationships.

● Unity: as learners strives to achieve common goals as they discuss barriers to harmonious relationships.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Social cohesion: learners work together and discuss in groups barriers to harmonious relationships.

Link to other learning areas:

● Creative Arts: as learners role play scenarios that depicts effective communication, negotiation skills, empathy, assertiveness in

overcoming barriers to healthy relationships.

digital resources, print resources, approved textbooks, signed audio visual clips,
